authority.scope: Native Windows 11 support without WSL for the complete Paperboat product surface
authority.truth_rule: A state is never promoted from implemented without evidence for the exact dimension. A compile result never counts as native execution evidence. A skipped test is not a pass.

The same Windows arm64 runtime matrix executed on native ARM64 hardware.
Windows amd64 and Windows arm64 clients and hosts interoperate in both directions.
A Windows client reaches a macOS host and exercises the feature under test.
A macOS client reaches a Windows host and exercises the feature under test.
A Windows client reaches a Linux host and exercises the feature under test.
A Linux client reaches a Windows host and exercises the feature under test.
Human-readable CLI, installer, dashboard, recovery, and support UX is equivalent to the other platforms.
JSON output, error codes, progress, cancellation, and machine-readable contracts are equivalent to the other platforms.
Server enrollment, admission, release policy, telemetry, persistence, and API behavior support Windows.
Dashboard display, channel controls, feature state, and recovery UX support Windows.
Release, signing, SBOM, provenance, TUF, updater, rollback, and rollout authority support Windows.
Documentation, support output, diagnostics, runbooks, and beta disclosures are complete for Windows.

evidence_catalog.note: The full repository builds for Windows amd64 and arm64. This remains compile evidence, not native execution evidence.

evidence_catalog.command: CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=windows GOARCH=arm64 go build -trimpath ./...; mapfile -t packages < <(go list ./...); for package in "${packages[@]}"; do CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=windows GOARCH=arm64 go test -c -vet=off -trimpath -tags paperboat_native_e2e,paperboat_native_network_e2e "$package"; done; validate every produced PE as ARM64
tests: every Go test package returned by go list ./..., including paperboat_native_e2e and paperboat_native_network_e2e build-tag paths
evidence_catalog.note: The Windows cross-test-packages CI lane compiles the complete ARM64 source graph and every discovered test package, then validates every generated PE has ARM64 machine type. This is the minimum cross-verification proof for a Windows-specific Go path; it is never native execution evidence.

tests: five release PE payloads have ARM64 machine type
portable ZIP has exact entries and ARM64 PE payloads
portable ZIP metadata declares Windows arm64 beta and requires native E2E before stable promotion
evidence_catalog.note: Victus cross-built the ARM64 release payload, MSI, and ZIP. The verifier reported five ARM64 PE payloads, MSI template Arm64;0, exact ZIP entries, beta metadata, and native-execution=false. Qualification SHA-256 values were 8188b789f51ad96495577ef0b9032f8984bbf6a505d4d823d931d04c2f94f69d for the 51,912,704-byte MSI and 9f53cdd043ba38ed00cb56ac68f29fb4cb36ed1a517e021aff556313a5670287 for the 30,089,273-byte ZIP. Release CI now runs the same verifier for both architectures after MSI and ZIP creation. This is artifact-structure evidence only; native ARM64 execution remains a separate blocked stable-promotion gate.

tests: IPv4 remains available without an IPv6 route
evidence_catalog.note: Windows now configures non-fragmenting Winsock UDP sockets before bind, so authenticated PMTU probes cannot report false success through IP fragmentation. The native amd64 socket-option suite passes and the full ARM64 test package compiles. Live path-reduction and Defender interaction remain separate evidence.
Windows host setup invokes the OpenSSH setup path, but the complete host setup flow is not qualified.

Native LTSC amd64 qualification passed against exact registered Microsoft.OpenSSH.Preview 10.0.0.0: Microsoft signature/version checks, dedicated PaperboatSshd, IPv4/IPv6 loopback ownership, public-key auth, PTY, exec, exit status, SCP and SFTP upload/download, restoration, and temporary-state cleanup. Repair and uninstall ownership passed. A real forced reboot restored automatic PaperboatSshd and post-boot protocol tests. Native crash qualification then exposed and fixed an orphaned-sshd defect by placing the child in a kill-on-close Job Object; terminating the wrapper now kills the old child, SCM restarts under a new PID after 5 seconds, exactly one IPv4/IPv6 listener pair remains, and the complete protocol suite passes. Fresh install and interrupted-install matrices remain.

tests: spaces and Unicode MSI source paths
forced reboot during active MSI transaction
evidence_catalog.note: Unsigned qualification MSIs passed natively on Victus from a 211-character source path containing spaces and Unicode while LongPathsEnabled=0: machine-wide silent install, repair, major upgrade, clean uninstall, reinstall, and a second clean uninstall. After enabling LongPathsEnabled and a real reboot, Paperboat natively completed a 313-character filesystem lifecycle and repeated the complete MSI lifecycle. A forced reboot after observable product state while msiexec remained active recovered to one coherent installation; the startup verifier then uninstalled it cleanly and preserved PaperboatSshd. A service-collision test exposed that the MSI overwrote an administrator-owned PaperboatHostd; registry AppSearch and a launch condition now fail closed before product changes, preserve the service exactly, and leave no files, registry, ARP, or updater service. A build-time-gated qualification-only failure scheduled after files and registry writes forced Windows Installer rollback with exit 1603; rollback removed every product file, service, registry value, and ARP entry. The same 2026.08.18.5/6 qualification MSIs then passed the complete normal lifecycle with the hook dormant. Release builds set the hook definition to zero and omit the custom action. Windows Installer itself rejected an MSI source path over 260 characters even in extended-path form, so that unsupported Windows Installer input is not claimed. Production signing remains separate.

Stable amd64 and explicit beta amd64/arm64 WinGet templates, final-hash renderer, winget.exe validation, release workflow wiring, deterministic portable ZIP tool, metadata contract, and package tests are present. WinGet rendering intentionally refuses unsigned MSIs, so final native rendering remains blocked on the production signing ceremony rather than missing implementation.

evidence_catalog.command: package-zip.ps1 --version 2026.08.18.7 --architecture amd64; Expand-Archive; pb.exe --version; pb.exe help
evidence_catalog.note: Victus created and extracted a three-file amd64 stable portable ZIP, validated paperboat.windows-portable/v1 metadata, and executed pb --version and pb help. The first execution exposed portable slash rejection in nested Windows user config paths; filepath.FromSlash normalization fixed it and the native userpaths suite plus portable commands passed. Qualification ZIP SHA-256 was 2c9ce95832f2f8b5c05cca61caea99e124353292871b2f4b7c2af38341a6b381. Final TUF-bound ZIP publication remains separate.

Victus and the Linux amd64 Hetzner host passed public-key exec, SCP, and SFTP in both directions. Linux reached the loopback-only PaperboatSshd through a temporary authenticated reverse tunnel, preserving the no-public-listener invariant. Payload hashes/content matched. Temporary keys, authorized-key changes, tunnel listener, and transfer files were removed; the original empty Paperboat authorized-keys file was restored and PaperboatSshd was restarted healthy. This proves SSH protocol interoperability only, not the full Paperboat control-plane/session matrix.

evidence_catalog.runner: victus and local macOS amd64 host
evidence_catalog.note: Victus and the local macOS host passed public-key exec, SCP, and SFTP in both directions through chained authenticated loopback forwards on the Linux test host. No Windows or macOS SSH endpoint was exposed publicly. SCP and SFTP round-trip SHA-256 hashes matched. Temporary authorized keys, forwarding processes, tunnel listeners, and Windows transfer files were removed; the original empty Paperboat authorized-keys file was restored and PaperboatSshd was restarted healthy. This proves SSH protocol interoperability only, not the full Paperboat control-plane/session matrix.
Credential Manager and encrypted DPAPI fallback code exists; native account-isolation and service-profile qualification remains pending.

Native LTSC amd64 evidence covers Credential Manager round-trip, DPAPI-protected fallback, deletion, missing-credential classification, and access-denied classification. User-scoped DPAPI decryption under logged-out S4U passed again after a real forced reboot. Multi-account and Credential Manager service-profile evidence remain open.

The focused native tests and the complete internal/localapi suite pass on LTSC amd64. Evidence covers protected named-pipe server/client transport, caller identity, snapshot/watch, completions, diagnostics, bug reports, peer probes and streams, transport observations, transfer-key leases and streams, upgrade framing, deadlines, cancellation, and cleanup. Cross-machine workflows and complete human/JSON CLI UX remain separate gates.
Known Folder implementation is cross-verified only. No native ARM64 execution claim is permitted until hardware is available.
FOLDERID_Downloads resolved to a canonical absolute path under the native SSH logon.
DownloadsDir uses Windows FOLDERID_Downloads and validates an absolute clean non-reparse path; native ARM64 execution remains unverified.

PE machine checks and exact TUF target verification are mandatory at initial host installation, CLI self-update, normal updater activation, and reboot rollback recovery. Authenticode publisher verification is enforced when a signature is present. Native amd64 updater recovery tests prove valid current-slot retention, atomic runtime/CLI rollback restoration, staged-file removal, and fail-closed behavior for untrusted current or rollback content without partial activation; ARM64 test packages compile. Final TUF-bound Paperboat artifacts are not present.

ConPTY production adapters and native terminal tests cover process startup, input/output, resize, Ctrl+C, UTF-8/VT, exit status, and Job Object cleanup. Replay and reconnect remain separate session-layer gates.

Native production-adapter qualification covers interactive cmd.exe continuity after Ctrl+C, foreground interruption, 101x37 resize, UTF-8 text, VT escape preservation, exit code 7, PowerShell 5.1, PowerShell 7, cmd.exe, and kill-on-close descendant cleanup. Testing exposed and fixed an invalid PROC_THREAD_ATTRIBUTE_PSEUDOCONSOLE value, explicit null standard-handle requirements, process-before-Job assignment race, CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP Ctrl+C suppression, and the need for a bounded descendant fallback when an inbox foreground command ignores ConPTY ETX. ARM64 builds and native test binaries compile but remain non-native evidence.

The production session manager and ConPTY adapter passed native session creation, ordered output, resize state, detach and bounded replay reconnect from a cursor, foreground Ctrl+C with shell survival, close, and delete cleanup in 0.49 seconds. The same native test package cross-compiles as ARM64, which is compile evidence only. Authenticated remote protocol and client restart matrices remain separate gates.

The production framed server, capability negotiation, request authorization, dispatcher, session manager, and ConPTY adapter passed native Windows create, attach, binary VT/output streaming, natural process exit, exact exit code 7, and terminal_stream_end delivery. Qualification exposed and fixed a ConPTY lifecycle cycle where capture waited for output EOF while the pseudoconsole remained open until capture called Wait; the process waiter now closes ConPTY after process exit while capture drains the final output. Existing native Ctrl+C, resize, and Job cleanup tests still pass. ARM64 server test packages cross-compile only. Production credential establishment and real network-carrier interoperability remain separate evidence.

Twenty-five native noninteractive executions passed exact argv, normalized environment overlay, working directory, separate stdout/stderr, complete output drain, and exit code 7. Qualification removed the child-before-Job race by creating every pipe process suspended, assigning it to the kill-on-close Job Object, and resuming its primary thread only after ownership succeeds. The ARM64 package and native test executable cross-compile only.

Victus passed real Winsock-owned IPv4 and IPv6 ICE nomination followed by pinned mutual endpoint identity, TLS 1.3 QUIC, exporter-bound first records, and application payload exchange. The first run exposed that Linux veth filtering also rejected Windows Hyper-V vEthernet external switches, leaving zero candidates; interface filtering is now OS-aware. Native QUIC also passed authenticated lifetime probes, HTTP/3 preview handoff, stream routing, malformed-frame fail-closed behavior, cancellation, and shutdown. Relay QUIC and WSS passed Noise IK identity/prologue binding, wire privacy, full-duplex HTTP/3, persistent authenticated attachment, bounded multiplexing, concurrent streams, health exchange, cancellation, rekey, replay/gap/tamper rejection, and clean shutdown. The loopback WebSocket carrier passed identity, framing, concurrent writes, limits, deadlines, cancellation, and close behavior. ARM64 packages cross-compile only. Live relay-service interoperability, WSS TLS/proxy policy, Defender profile changes, and network migration remain separate gates.

evidence_catalog.command: networkmonitor-windows-amd64.test.exe -test.v -test.timeout 1m -test.run TestNativeWindowsObserverReceivesExternalInterfaceChange; SYSTEM toggles vEthernet (Default Switch) for 15 seconds with finally restoration
evidence_catalog.note: The production Tailscale-backed Windows observer started natively, produced a stable opaque fingerprint, and detected a controlled Hyper-V Default Switch disable/enable as generation 1, interface-address reason, rebind required, dual-stack viable. The adapter was restored by a SYSTEM task finally block, the task was removed, SSH stayed available through the untouched path, and PaperboatSshd remained running. A 3-second toggle coalesced without an event; holding the change for 15 seconds passed, documenting the backend debounce requirement. The qualification-only test is separately tagged paperboat_native_network_e2e and compiled for amd64 and ARM64 by CI; it requires external controlled mutation and is not run by ordinary unit CI. Active session/path replacement, VPN, NAT rebinding, and sleep/wake remain separate evidence.

Windows process adapters, suspended process creation before race-free Job assignment, LSA S4U token acquisition, profile loading, privilege stripping, and CreateProcessAsUser passed focused native amd64 tests. After a real forced reboot with no interactive owner session, logged-out S4U again passed DPAPI, Git, Codex, outbound TCP, owner profile, and process-tree execution; EFS remained ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED. Fast-user-switch remains open.

Windows 11 IoT Enterprise LTSC build 26100 native amd64 qualification passed with the enrolled owner logged out: S4U owner SID, service session 0, loaded profile and environment, CreateProcessAsUser, owner-created user-scoped DPAPI decryption, suspended Job assignment, descendant termination, and service cleanup. Credentialed SMB remains explicitly not qualified by this evidence. ARM64 test packages cross-compile only.

Pinned handles, final-path identity, protected ACLs, single-link checks, held ancestor directories, cancellation, and executable pinning passed native adversarial tests. ARM64 test binaries cross-compile but have no native evidence.
Service adapters and PaperboatSshd registration code exist; complete unattended host qualification is pending.
Native Windows managed SSH, authorized keys, agent endpoint, listener, ProxyCommand, SCP, and SFTP paths exist and cross-compile; remaining directional interoperability is tracked separately.
ACL-protected named-pipe client/server transport, peer token checks, snapshot/watch, peer streams, transfer leases, and daemon integration passed focused native amd64 tests.
Native Windows runtime, worker, service, doctor, purge, and entry paths exist. Core service and unattended S4U behavior passed focused native amd64 tests.
Native Windows config, preview, serve, hosted hooks, and runtime entry paths exist and cross-compile; broader end-to-end config and protocol qualification remains tracked per feature.
Windows stable/beta metadata and admission validation exist; TUF publication and native qualification evidence remain pending.
Server platform allow-list and Windows artifact admission support exist and are covered by focused tests.

Windows 11 IoT Enterprise LTSC amd64 build 26100.9168, with no selectable owner WTS token: SCM/LocalSystem/S4U passed owner SID, profile, DPAPI, native Git, outbound TCP, signed native Codex 0.147.0, descendants, and Job cleanup. EFS encryption failed with ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED and remains a stable blocker. Credentialed SMB remains unqualified because S4U has no reusable network credentials.

The package-level Windows amd64 and arm64-cross suites pass, including encrypted send/receive, authenticated chunk resume, restart recovery, atomic publication, collisions, exact bytes, digest and replay rejection, cancellation, backpressure, key erasure, and durable receipts. Live control-plane transfer is not qualified: Victus fails during transfer-key acknowledgement with EOF after transport health succeeds, while a Linux host currently fails a later direct-path descriptor attempt. This evidence is therefore partial until the transfer-key protocol and path fallback are repaired and Windows, Linux, and macOS interoperability pass end to end.

The complete config, config-apply, and 62-test config-sync package suites passed natively on Windows 11 IoT Enterprise LTSC amd64 build 26100.9168 and compile for Windows arm64. Coverage includes manifests, native Git repositories, snapshots, watches, bounded shutdown flush, atomic apply journals, restart recovery, three-way merge, conflict preservation/resolution, restore, status, leases, and resource limits. Qualification fixed POSIX-mode misuse, native protected-ACL validation, stable Windows metadata normalization, open-journal deletion, rollback ACL restoration, and Windows fsnotify shutdown. External native Chezmoi execution, credential-helper interoperability, CLI UX, and cross-platform sync remain separate gates.

The complete native Windows cmd/pb, hostruntime/service, and hostruntime/runtime suites pass on Windows 11 IoT Enterprise LTSC amd64 build 26100.9168 and cross-compile for arm64. Dynamic preview, private-preview, and detached-serve SCM entries launch only through the enrolled owner WTS/S4U token and a kill-on-close Job, never as the LocalSystem workload. A disposable logged-out standard owner qualification proves the installed LocalSystem PaperboatHostd launches both its broker client and dynamic preview workers under the exact owner SID, non-elevated, in session 0; install, single removal, bulk removal, expiry reconciliation, clean service stop, and a second SCM start all pass. It then deletes the enrolled owner while Hostd is running; the LocalSystem parent detects the now-unmapped SID, closes the owner Job Object, and fails the service closed. Recreating the same account name produces a new SID and PaperboatHostd rejects it instead of transferring machine ownership. A separate forced-reboot qualification proved a newer Windows boot, automatic SCM startup without Start-Service, the same complete session-0 broker lifecycle, exact cleanup, unchanged shared ProgramData ACL, and unchanged PaperboatSshd service, managed SSH files, ACLs, and firewall inventory. Those qualifications exposed and fixed remove-all validation, a premature test-worker exit race, and missing active owner-deletion monitoring. Standard-user lifecycle operations use the persistent PaperboatHostd LocalSystem parent through a protected local-only named pipe with exact owner-SID verification, a domain-separated installation capability, bounded framing, concurrency, deadlines, explicit readiness, and service-fatal failure propagation. Normal commands never launch UAC; elevation is limited to setup, repair, and uninstall. The parent self-removes one-shot services after owner-workload expiry; descriptors use protected owner/SYSTEM/Administrators ACLs. Public registration E2E remains unverified.

Native Victus suites pass loopback HTTP health preflight, fresh per-request streams, two separately flushed SSE chunks, WebSocket upgrade and binary echo over the private-preview host protocol, cancellation of listeners and active streams, loopback-only serve binding, requested-port conflict handling, source pinning, traversal and reparse protection, expiry, lease loss, and cleanup. Full public control-plane registration, cross-machine reconnect, and SCM reboot recovery remain separate gates.
The existing release workflow requires signing evidence, but this ledger does not claim that evidence exists.
The user-approved Windows plan and this ledger are the authoritative platform scope.
Workflow configuration defines the hosted matrix; execution evidence is recorded separately by run.
All Windows jobs passed. ARM64 remains beta by product policy; this evidence does not promote it to stable.
Existing operational documentation covers parts of Windows distribution and signing; this ledger records the remaining gaps.
